tests.name: Enqueue, read, dequeue
First in, first out
tests.setup:
q = Queue()
q.enqueue(1)
q.enqueue(2)
q.dequeue()
q.enqueue(3)
q.enqueue(4)

tests.name: 300 000 in, 300 000 out
tests.setup:
q = Queue()
for i in range(300000):
    q.enqueue(i)
first = q.read()
total = 0
while not q.is_empty():
    last = q.dequeue()
    total += last
tests.hint: list.pop(0) is O(N), so emptying a big queue is O(N^2). Use deque.popleft().
